page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No margin notes, since the strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page's edge. Top: page number ornament. Bottom: signature and catchword.

main_text.p: Simplicissimus, nec perfectissimus nec immutabilis. Vita hæc Dei cùm ita sit perfectissima & infinita dicitur immortalitas.
IV. Facultates sunt Dei proprietates per quas essentia divina a nobis concipitur per perfe-ctissimas vitalium operationum vires.

Hæ nihil sunt aliud quàm purissimi actus, à nobis tamen per modum Facultatum concipiuntur, in quantum facultates permanentem quandam perfectionem exprimunt: Vires autem hæ nullo modo sunt passiva, sed perfectis-simè activa, ideoque superiores Dei proprietates, quæ ipsi competunt quatenus est Ens primum, omnibus ac singulis sunt applicandæ.
V. Facultates divinæ Essentiæ sunt intelle-ctus, Voluntas & Potentia executiva divina.

Cùm Deus sit ens non factum ac simplicissimum, necessa[illegible, ~2 letters]riò est Spiritus, & quidem perfe-ctissimus & plane immaterialis : Si Spiritus, utique hæ tres facultates ipsi necessariò competunt, quia, ad intrinsecam Spiritus perfectionem requiruntur.
VI. In hisce autem spectandus cujusq; facultatis, tum actus, tum virtutes; Actus consi-deratur ratione Dei agentis, Objectorum Agibilium & modi Agendi.

page.notes: Printed text is all in the central column. The left-edge strip shows fragments of the facing page and was left out. Doubtful: the word after "necessa" in the fifth paragraph is largely hidden and marked illegible. Likely "necessariò", but not read. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. The printed spacing "immaterialis :" and "virtutes ;" is kept as printed.
